description: This file defines a custom widget called CustomAppBar, used as a reusable app bar component in a Flutter application. It implements PreferredSizeWidget, providing a consistent height and styling including a title and optional actions.

classes.name: CustomAppBar
classes.description: A Flutter widget that creates a styled app bar with a title and optional action buttons, implementing PreferredSizeWidget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI of the CustomAppBar widget, returning an AppBar with specified title, background color, and actions.

methods.name: preferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size (height) of the app bar, fixed at 56 pixels.
